_comment: Loot tables for the lootable-site layer (LOOT_SITES_SPEC.md §5). A table is rolled `rolls` times; each roll picks one entry by weight, and an entry marked `unique` is removed from the table once it has been picked so a single resolution cannot pay out the same relic twice. Resource entries roll min..max inclusive. Relic entries name a rarity TIER, not a relic -- LootCatalog picks an undrawn relic of that tier, so the first set can grow by editing relics.json alone. TUNE THESE HERE, NOT IN CODE: tools/verify_loot_tables.tscn re-derives every ratio below from this file against the §5 band table in a 10k-roll simulation, so a weight edited here is a number the harness will argue with.

small_cache.exception: Amendment 2026-08-29 ruling 1: the gold and the trinket ARE the cache. Wood, stone and food are garnish at low weight and small amounts -- a cache whose best outcome is wood is a bug by §1.1's first law, so this table deliberately breaks Band 1's gold band upward and the harness asserts gold-dominance instead of the band.

abandoned_camp.comment: Amendment ruling 2: the camp is one of the three human sites that can turn up arms, at a small chance -- somebody left in a hurry and did not take everything.

wolf_den.exception: RELIC COLUMN ONLY. §5 authorises exactly one thing here -- the best wolfhide_cloak odds in the game (~24% against the band's ~15%) -- so the resource columns are held to Band 2 like any other site and the harness checks them. The gold is what the pack dragged in with whatever it last ate; the wolves have no use for it. No arms: amendment ruling 2 is explicit that arms are human sites only.

derelict_graveyard.comment: Per grave. The school: Band-2 ratios, no watcher, no notice ever.

village_graveyard.comment: Per grave. Sits between the derelict and the church: better than Band 2, short of Band 3, and someone is sometimes watching.

church_cemetery.comment: Per grave, and the best grave loot in the run -- §5's Band-3 row, kept for the church exactly as the amendment asks.

crypt.exception: RELIC COLUMN ONLY. `guaranteed` is honoured by the roller before the weighted rolls, so the crypt pays a rare-or-better every single time -- which no percentage describes, and which is why the harness asserts 100% here instead of a band. The three resource columns are held to Band 4 like anything else.
crypt.comment: The rare entry is guaranteed rather than weighted, so the four weighted rolls are all the heavy Dark Essence the crypt is really made of.

outlaw_cave.exception: RELIC COLUMN ONLY, and only because the guaranteed arms sit in the mundane column rather than the relic one -- the cave's ~28% rare is deliberately under the Band-4 ~40%, because what it really pays is the hoard and the weapons. The three resource columns are held to Band 4.
outlaw_cave.comment: Amendment ruling 2: the hoard gains GUARANTEED arms. This is where you get weapons without paying the Workshop for them.

cursed_battlefield.comment: Mass bones, and amendment ruling 2's arms lying where they fell. No exception: it is held to Band 4 on all four columns, and the gold is what was in the purses of everyone who did not walk away.
